evidence_class: independent occurrence-record source, conditional positive-only diagnostic if future species-and-island identities qualify; not movement, colonization or survey-absence data

source.method: ABS island polygons with ALA mammal event points assigned to FID in original published workflow; independent of original IUCN polygon-overlay response source but nonuniform observation effort

original.original_label_ontology: IUCN range-overlap mapped and augmented positive-cell proxy, not directly surveyed occupancy

geometry_gate.geometry_format: ESRI shapefile in ZIP; metadata/geometry only
geometry_gate.crs: read source .prj WKT, project original WGS84 island centroids into native polygon CRS
geometry_gate.original_match_condition: original island centroid covered by exactly one corrected-Australian-island polygon AND ratio of GIS polygon area to original island area within [0.25,4] (both km2)

future_species_gate.taxon_source: ALA mammal record taxonomy from immutable source ZIP after successful geography freeze only

endpoint_boundary.allowed_future: positive-only ALA occurrence events on one-to-one matched frozen original heldout islands; same frozen p_R3,p_C predictions only, with no model refit
endpoint_boundary.unsupported: 0-coded missing ALA records cannot be treated as surveyed absence; no demographic rescue or colonization inference
